rules.precondition: Every before and every published after is a canonical valid Layout graph.
rules.threadDeletion: Refuse removal if a surviving local frame points into the removed frame set.
rules.pageCreation: Append the new page id to its existing spread while inserting the page at index; inverse restores both page and spread positions.
rules.storySplice: Offsets/delete count Unicode scalar characters; style ranges count UTF-8 bytes. Keep surviving prefix/suffix of each run. Inserted text inherits every run containing the character at the splice start (right bias), or ending there at story EOF (left bias). Drop fully removed nonempty runs without inherited text. Keep zero-length anchors, moving anchors inside the replaced range to the end of inserted text. Preserve run order and overlapping styles; semantic undo restores the exact original run vector.
